summary: First lookout 1934 (L-4 pole); present R-6 cab on a 20-ft timber tower from 1964, staffed in summer on the Lolo National Forest.

facts.design: R-6 flat cab on a 20-ft treated timber tower

access.note: Reached from the Stark Mountain Trailhead by Trail #58; the lookout is staffed in summer

visit.trail_note: About 4 miles on Stark Mountain Trail #58 from the trailhead

events.note: First lookout: an L-4 cab on a 30-ft pole tower
Present R-6 flat cab on a 20-ft treated timber tower replaced the pole tower
Virginia Vincent had staffed the lookout for 30 years as of the register entry
32 fires ignited on the Ninemile Ranger District on August 4, 2000

evidence.quote: Stark Mountain Lookout on the Lolo National Forest

evidence.supports: first lookout an L-4 on 30 ft pole; present R6 cab on 20 ft timber tower replaced it in 1964

evidence.supports: Virginia Vincent staffed the lookout for 30 years
evidence.quote: That has not deterred Virginia Vincent who has staffed the lookout for 30 years.

corrections.proposed: 1934 built (first L-4 pole lookout); 1964 replaced it with the present R-6 cab
corrections.why: 1964 dates the present cab, not the first lookout; sources date the first lookout on the summit to 1934.

sources.title: Stark Mountain Trailhead
sources.publisher: USDA Forest Service, Lolo National Forest

notes_for_editor: Brief's R-6 design, 1964 replacement date and NHLR registration (July 14, 2000) are supported. The brief's height_m of 9.1 is not supported by any source read (firelookout.com and the NHLR give only the 20-ft tower), so height_m is omitted. Staffing is seasonal per the USFS trailhead page; the as_of date is the read date because that page is undated. The 30-years staffing figure is from 2000 and is not current. No source read reports a restoration or closure. Elevation is not a facts key and was not used.
